title: Impulse Call Out Text 2
description:
“Once momentum is added, the soloist is being pushed and pulled off balance all the time, which constantly changes the situation of the body in relation to the floor. The speed of the interactions between all the motors and other elements involved doesn’t allow for very much conscious control.”
----- Thomas Hauert
